about.summary: An interactive multimodal AI assistant combining conversational AI, 3D motion synthesis, and voice I/O. Built for those passionate about real-time 3D character animation and AI-driven motion generation — no pre-recorded animations required.
about.who_we_are_body: — a team of final-year students who started this project as a graduation assignment. We are driven by a shared passion for real-time 3D rendering, AI, and human-computer interaction, aiming to push the boundaries of what virtual assistants can be.
